meta.title: How to Fund OHC Foundation
meta.description: Send a direct grant, bank transfer, or donation to Open Healthcare Network Foundation. Account details, wire transfer instructions, and tax benefit information for Indian and international funders.

hero.title: How to fund us.
hero.body: Send a direct bank transfer or international wire to OHC Foundation. Donations support open healthcare infrastructure used by hospitals, public health programs, and governments.

bankTransfer.body: Transfer directly to the foundation's current account. Use your organisation name or donor name as the reference.
bankTransfer.receiptNote: * Contact <link>{email}</link> after transfer to receive a donation receipt.

international.title: From outside India
international.body: For international donors and institutional funders, please contact the finance team before initiating a transfer. We will confirm current FCRA status and provide the correct wire details.

orgDetails.title: Payee and compliance identifiers.
orgDetails.body: Use these for grant applications, wire transfers, donation forms, or when your compliance team needs to verify the receiving entity.

taxBenefits.title: 80G deduction for Indian donors.
taxBenefits.body: OHC Foundation holds a provisional 80G registration. Indian resident individuals and companies can claim deduction on donations under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

deduction.title: 80G deduction
deduction.description: Indian resident donors can claim deduction on the donated amount under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

receipts.title: Donation receipts
receipts.description: Official receipts for all donations are issued by the foundation. Contact {email} after transferring funds.

fcra.title: FCRA status
fcra.description: For international wire transfers, contact us to confirm current FCRA status and applicable compliance requirements.

whatYouFund.title: The institutional work behind every deployment.
whatYouFund.body: Funding OHC Foundation is not funding one hospital or one deployment. It funds the shared platform, governance, release practices, documentation, security, and implementation ecosystem that make many deployments safer and less expensive to repeat.

careCore.title: CARE Core
careCore.description: Shared healthcare primitives, APIs, workflows, FHIR-aligned data models, and platform reliability that every deployment depends on.

security.title: Security and LTS
security.description: Release discipline, quality assurance, vulnerability response, auditability, and long-term support across active deployments.

documentation.title: Documentation and guides
documentation.description: Implementation guides, deployment packs, technical references, training material, and reusable playbooks for new deployments.

ecosystem.title: Implementation ecosystem
ecosystem.description: System integrator enablement, plugin compatibility, contribution pathways, and localization support across languages and regions.

ai.title: Assistive AI for health
ai.description: Human-in-the-loop documentation, voice-native forms, summarization, and safe workflow support for clinicians and staff.

southToSouth.title: South-to-South reuse
southToSouth.description: Deployment patterns and country-ready infrastructure that can be adapted beyond one state or program.

tiers.title: Flexible arrangements for any funder type.
tiers.body: Funding can be structured as a one-time grant, annual sponsorship, institutional membership, or program-targeted support. Contact the finance team to discuss the arrangement that fits your organisation.

visionary.title: Visionary Sponsor
visionary.description: Major philanthropic or institutional support for stewarding open healthcare digital public infrastructure at scale.
visionary.note: Contact us to discuss scope and structure.

member.title: Foundation Member
member.description: Annual membership for companies, healthcare providers, implementation partners, and ecosystem organizations.

program.title: Program Sponsor
program.description: Targeted support for CARE Core, security, AI documentation, palliative care, TeleICU, or deployment packs.

individual.title: Individual Supporter
individual.description: One-time or recurring support from individuals who want to back open healthcare infrastructure and the OHC mission.
individual.note: 80G tax deduction eligible for Indian donors.

contact.title: We'll guide you through the process.
contact.body: Whether you're sending a small individual contribution or structuring a large institutional grant, the finance team is available to help with receipts, documentation, compliance, and reporting.
contact.documentsText: COI, MOA, PAN, 80G, 12A, GST, and other legal certificates.
